Karar anahtarı.
Now points to the continuous. These days and nowadays usually come with a temporary or changing situation, and they usually call for the continuous. Usually calls for the simple present.
Gelecekte ayrım başka.
A personal arrangement takes the continuous. A fixed timetable takes the simple present. Usually a person makes the arrangement, and a thing follows the timetable.
Fiil de karar verir. Believe, have ve recommend -ing almaz. Bunu tuzak bölümünde açacağız.

Both mean the future. The structure differs because one is a personal arrangement and the other is a fixed timetable.

Usually points to a habit. Now points to this moment.

İki boşluk, iki sinyal. Usually geniş zaman ister: spends. Now şimdiki zaman ister: is meeting. Doğru cevap B şıkkı. Çeldirici D şıkkı ve C şıkkı: usually ile -ing çelişir. Çeldirici A şıkkı: now ile geniş zaman çelişir. Çeldirici E şıkkı: özne Nancy ile uyumsuz.

Our company is going through a hard period these days, but we believe this situation is temporary.
A hard period is temporary, so it takes the continuous. Believe takes the simple present in this sense: we believe, not we are believing.
